about: B8 (ROADMAP 6.7). budget = the target from docs/plans/phase6.md 'Budgets'; ci = the ceiling scripts/perf.sh fails above (default 2 x budget; a few are set from a measured miss, see docs/log/2026-10-23-p6-b8-perf.md). Do not loosen a budget without the coordinator. Timing rows are not failed when the loadavg seen during the run reached 8 (PERF_LOAD_SKIP); a full run fails on any unmeasured row. A row with loadSkipGuard F (cold arrival, first tile, /locate fresh) still fails (exit 5, PERF SKIPPED ROW FAR OVER CEILING) when it is skipped for load but above F x ci: a load-skip hides noise, not a 10x regression (F set from the loaded runs of 2026-10-26..29; PERF_SKIP_FAR overrides every F).
